sensor: Linear displacement transducer or optical/laser displacement system
location: Carriage relative to fixed rail/base datum
frame: P0 longitudinal +X axis defined from rail travel direction
rate_basis: Select full-scale range > maximum safe bench stroke; resolution sufficient to resolve smallest planned variant difference; exact range set after measured/fixture envelope survey
sampling: Quasi-static >=1 kS/s; dynamic >=20 kS/s unless the validated signal bandwidth requires higher
calibration: Traceable calibration before campaign; zero/span check every test day
uncertainty: Document full measurement uncertainty budget; propagate to velocity/energy where derived
raw: CSV with UTC/local test timestamp, channel ID, units, calibration ID

sensor: Load cell or instrumented load path
location: Left rail/base interface or in-line reaction path
frame: +X longitudinal force sign positive in forward travel direction
rate_basis: Full scale above verified structural test envelope with overload protection
sampling: >=20 kS/s for controlled dynamic tests; lower may be used for quasi-static
calibration: Traceable force calibration; shunt/zero check as applicable
uncertainty: Report calibrated force uncertainty and installation compliance

sensor: Load cell or instrumented load path
uncertainty: Report independently so load asymmetry can be computed

sensor: In-line force transducer or instrumented actuator/load frame
location: Coaxial with 130 cartridge on each tested side
frame: Force positive in absorber compression/loading direction defined by cartridge datum
rate_basis: Range shall exceed verified design-reference force envelope; do not use 18-22 or 25-35 kN as guaranteed test values
uncertainty: Include force cell, alignment, fixture compliance and DAQ uncertainty

sensor: Rotary encoder/angular transducer or calibrated inertial angle system
location: Seatback frame relative to carriage/base reference
frame: Positive rotation direction defined by right-hand rule about seatback hinge axis
rate_basis: Range shall cover full safe P0 envelope with mechanical over-travel protection
calibration: Angular zero and scale verification before each test block

location: Rigid carriage mass/fixture datum near reference CG of moving assembly
frame: Axes co-located/aligned to P0 frame as surveyed
rate_basis: Range selected from pre-test measured dynamic envelope with overload margin; no crash-pulse assumption
sampling: >=20 kS/s minimum, higher if validated bandwidth requires
uncertainty: Include mounting resonance/axis misalignment in uncertainty discussion

frame: Local joint coordinate system tied to P0 datums
rate_basis: Chosen to resolve measured elastic/clearance range

sensor: Discrete state switch/encoder/proximity target + high-speed video
frame: State is categorical, synchronized to global DAQ time base
rate_basis: State transition faster than required identification bandwidth

location: Representative absorber body and/or fluid/ambient points permitted by supplier
frame: Temperature channels are scalar with location metadata
rate_basis: Range covers qualified lab conditions; exact bounds per absorber supplier test capability
sampling: >=100 S/s during transients; slower soak logging acceptable

location: Side and/or rear view with whole mechanism and target joints visible
frame: Camera calibration transforms to P0 coordinates
rate_basis: Frame rate selected from measured motion frequency so event transition/stroke/rotation are temporally resolved
sampling: >=1000 fps only as an initial planning floor; final rate determined from pre-test motion measurement and shutter/lighting requirements
calibration: Lens/distortion calibration + spatial scale + timebase sync
raw: Original image sequence + calibration file + time sync record
